BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving the greater west Michigan area.
We are located in Grand Rapids, serving the communities of Grandville, Holland, Muskegon, Caledonia, Lowell, Wyoming, Kentwood, Cascade, Coopersville, Byron Center, Walker, Zeeland and western Michigan.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency medicine
No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet and walk-ins are welcome. As with human emergency rooms, the most life-threatening cases are triaged first. Our veterinary team will evaluate patients when they arrive to collect vital signs prior to an examination by one of our emergency doctors.
There may be times when more stable patients may need to wait so critical patients can be stabilized. Please know that every patient is important to us. We will take all the necessary steps to ensure all patients receive the care they need.
Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Grand Rapids.
Our veterinarians are leaders in low-stress handling to promote calm and comfort for pets in our care. As the premier emergency and specialty hospital for pets in western Michigan, our 21,000-square-foot hospital is equipped with human-quality medical technology and equipment. The devoted and skilled team is ready to provide the highest quality care and attention for your pet, and clinical staff is onsite 24/7 for patient care. Whether it’s an emergency or your family vet office is closed, we’re here to help.
Since becoming part of BluePearl in 2008, we have been expanding our range of specialty services to better serve our patients and the veterinary community. Our diagnostic equipment includes a CT scanner, endoscopy, MRI, ultrasound, endolaser, diode laser and digital radiology. Our staff strives to keep you informed, so you’ll know exactly how your pet is doing.

At BluePearl, providing our clients with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.

Testimonials.
I noticed Finley not feeling good and worried he had a bladder infection or constipation. I took him in to be seen. When we arrived, he was taken right back to be checked. The doctor and her staff were wonderful with him. Yesterday he sat like a loaf of bread all day, and today he is back to his comfy self. He just wants to thank you all for loving him and being so great with him.
Read More
Amanda H.
My two year old cat was diagnosed with a heart murmur. A week before he was scheduled for his echocardiogram he began to show signs of labored breathing. I called to see if I could get him into emergency vet care here in Kalamazoo, but they were not excepting any new patients. My vet suggested a few places all an hour a way. BluePearl Grand Rapids was one of those places.
Marley was extremely helpful in explaining cost and even suggested Care Credit if approved is a great way to help with both human and pet medical expenses. Bryce also was kind and amazing. He knew I was on my way and got us checked in quickly and up into a room. The doctors and assistants are both very knowledgeable and provide you with options that fit your budget.
I will make the drive to BluePearl for any future pet emergencies. Well worth the drive. Professional, compassionate and patient staff. Thank you all for taking such good care of my boy!
Read More
Amanda F.
Miles came in with a life threatening bacterial infection and was in dire condition. The team at BluePearl Grand Rapids took such good care of him as he had to stay in the hospital a couple of nights. They were able to target the infection and he came home with us. He has a long road ahead but he is looking better every day. Thank you for saving him. He is very loved.
Read More
Lori V.
They literally saved [Blanche’s] life. The care from BluePearl was extremely reassuring during a time when we were very anxious.
